name: Klanggarten – Singing Garden
subtitle: Sing, grow, make music
promo: Your child's voice grows singing creatures: flowers, mushrooms and pumpkins sing it back. Offline, no ads, no reading needed – made for ages 3 to 6.
description:
In Klanggarten, your child's voice is the seed. High notes grow delicate flowers, low notes grow chubby mushrooms and pumpkins, loud sounds become big creatures and soft sounds small ones. Each creature sings your child's sound back, automatically tuned so everything fits together like a tiny orchestra. Tap the conductor's baton and the whole garden plays a concert with fireworks. Sunshine makes every sound brighter and faster, rain makes it deeper and slower, and then a rainbow appears. In the echo game a creature sings first and your child answers. Four seasons transform the garden. After a few minutes evening falls and everyone drifts off to sleep: a gentle way to end playtime.

For parents:
• Made for ages 3–6: no reading, no scores, no time pressure
• Works without a microphone too, with 12 built-in sounds
• Recordings never leave the device: offline, no ads, no in-app purchases, no data collection
• Parents' area behind a maths question: microphone, volume, play time, language, season, delete recordings, save the concert as an audio file
• Supports listening skills, self-efficacy and early musicality
